credits.title: The Haunters
credits.overview: Three obnoxious "paranormal investigators" disrupt the peace and quiet of a haunted library.

credits.title: You Can't Leave
credits.overview: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

credits.title: Room 203
credits.overview: Two female roommates were tormented by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their gothic-style, rented apartment, which contains an ornate centerpiece.
